messages:
jamal: Quick triage: new customer onboarding failing in their CI. Symptom: Node SDK preflight returns 401 intermittently then 429s. They use ephemeral tokens and cloud CI runners with connection pooling.

olivia: Do we have SDK version + snippet?

jamal: v1.0.0-preview, logs:
```
2026-03-20T11:02:01Z WARN auth:preflight 401 expired_ephemeral
2026-03-20T11:02:01Z INFO auth:refresh got_new_token
2026-03-20T11:02:01Z ERROR server:quota 429 preflight_quota_exceeded
```

jamal: They reported they use a managed NAT gateway that does source NAT and keeps upstream TLS sessions, so multiple workers share same TCP/TLS tunnel. They also rotate ephemeral tokens every 20s.

support-bot: Suggested fix: enable token caching + add preflight jitter.

olivia: Added action items: 1) temporary quota bump for onboarding, 2) ask them to add ephemeral-token cache, 3) check for clock skew. I filed support ticket CS-9842.

rachel: Note for KB: include examples for bash/node/python token cache + recommended splay values (100-300ms) and concurrency caps (<=10 per host). Also recommend increasing token TTL to >=60s if they control the token service.

jamal: Customer applied the cache and jitter and failures stopped. Closing after 24h stable run.

support-bot: CS-9842 -> resolved :white_check_mark:
